يستوجب (form X)
# يَسْتَوْجِبُ (yastawjibu) /jas.taw.d͡ʒi.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَوْجَبَ (istawjaba)
# يُسْتَوْجَبُ (yustawjabu) /jus.taw.d͡ʒa.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَوْجَبَ (istawjaba)
# يَسْتَوْجِبَ (yastawjiba) /jas.taw.d͡ʒi.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْت
